query: For W–Cu metal-matrix composites used in heat-dissipation and fusion-reactor joint applications, what single intervention could increase thermal conductivity while retaining mechanical durability and irradiation resistance? Formulate one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains its mechanism, predicts the outcome relative to an otherwise comparable W–Cu composite, defines the application conditions under which it should hold, cites supporting prior evidence, and specifies an experiment whose result would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: Introducing a controlled amount of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) into the W-Cu composite matrix can enhance thermal conductivity while maintaining mechanical durability and irradiation resistance.
generation.intervention: Introduction of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) into the composite matrix
generation.conditions: Heat-dissipation and fusion-reactor joint applications, with operating temperatures up to 1000°C and irradiation doses up to 10 dpa
generation.structural_mediator: CNT network formation within the composite
generation.mechanism: Enhanced phonon transport and increased thermal interface conductance due to the high thermal conductivity of CNTs
generation.predicted_outcome: Increased thermal conductivity by at least 20% compared to the baseline W-Cu composite, with no significant degradation in mechanical durability or irradiation resistance
generation.boundary: CNT concentration below 5 vol.% to avoid compromising mechanical properties
generation.uncertainty: Limited understanding of CNT dispersion and interfacial interactions within the W-Cu matrix, potential for CNT degradation under irradiation

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative thermal conductivity and mechanical testing of W-Cu composites with and without CNTs, under controlled irradiation conditions
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the thermal conductivity of the CNT-modified W-Cu composite is not significantly higher than the baseline composite, or if mechanical durability or irradiation resistance is compromised, the hypothesis is falsified.
